## Meet the Team

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(readxl)
team_data <- read_excel("data.xlsx")

cat('<div class="grid">')

for(i in 1:nrow(team_data)) {
  person <- team_data[i, ]
  
  # Image check logic
  photo_path <- paste0("images/team/", person$Photo)
  if (!file.exists(photo_path) | is.na(person$Photo)) {
    display_photo <- paste0("[https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=](https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=)", 
                            URLencode(person$Name), 
                            "&background=random&rounded=true")
  } else {
    display_photo <- photo_path
  }

  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4 g-col-lg-3">',
      '<div class="flip-card">',
        '<div class="flip-card-inner">',
          
          # FRONT: Photo and Name Only
          '<div class="flip-card-front">',
            '<img src="', display_photo, '" class="rounded-circle mb-3" style="width: 150px; height: 150px; object-fit: cover;">',
            '<h4>', person$Name, '</h4>',
          '</div>',
          
          # BACK: Role, Bio, and Email
          '<div class="flip-card-back">',
            '<h5 class="mb-1">', person$Role, '</h5>',
            '<p class="small">', person$Bio, '</p>',
            '<hr style="width: 50%; border-color: white; margin: 10px auto;">',
            '<a href="mailto:', person$Email, '" style="color: #abdbe3;">', person$Email, '</a>',
          '</div>',
          
        '</div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  ))
}

cat('</div>')
```
